aR.signInToKeep: Sign in to keep your designs safe and use them on other phones. It is optional.

aRScreenGate.arNeedsADevelopment: AR needs a development build (ARCore/ARKit). It is not available in Expo Go.

forgotPassword.enterYourEmailIf: Enter your email. If there is an account for it, we will send a 6-digit code.

resetPassword.signInWithYour: Sign in with your new password. Other phones have been signed out.

signIn.backUpYourDesigns: Back up your designs and saved furniture, and bring them to your other phones. The app works fully without an account.

signUp.password8CharactersNot: Password (8+ characters, not a common one)
signUp.weWillEmailYou: We will email you a 6-digit code to confirm your address.

verifyEmail.youCanUseThe: You can use the app without verifying. Cloud backup starts once your email is confirmed.

designs.noSavedDesignsYet: No saved designs yet. Place furniture in AR and tap Save.
designs.tapTheHeartOn: Tap the heart on a piece to keep it here.

item.thisItemIsNo: This item is no longer available.
item.thisPhoneDoesNot: This phone does not support AR, so you can place the piece on a to-scale plan of your room instead.
item.inArThisIs: In AR this is shown as a simplified shape at the real size, to check fit and layout. It is not a realistic model of the product.

library.noFurnitureMatchesClear: No furniture matches. Clear the search to see more.

plan.itIsInYour: It is in your Saved tab, where you can share it or open it in AR.

plan.statusGood: Looks good. Drag a piece to move it.

roomDetail.thisRoomIsNo: This room is no longer available.

settings.changeTheRoomType: Change the room type or size used for suggestions.
settings.shareAnonymousUsageWhich: Share anonymous usage (which screens and features are used: ids and numbers only, never camera images or room shapes).
settings.backupPhotos: Back up design photos: a picture of your room is uploaded with each saved design. Off by default. A design's photo is also uploaded when you share it.
settings.photoModelsHint: Shapes made from product photos. Less accurate than the standard shapes.

sharedDesign.aCopyIsIn: A copy is in your Saved tab.

welcome.seeItInYour: See it in your room before you decide.
welcome.placeTrueToSize: Place true-to-size furniture in your space with your camera, try curated rooms, and get suggestions that fit.
welcome.theCameraIsOnly: The camera is only used on your phone to measure and place furniture. Camera images never leave it.
welcome.noAr: This phone cannot do AR, so you will draw your room on a plan instead.
welcome.scanNote: A camera scan replaces this guess with measured numbers.

accountSection.lastChanceEverythingWill: Last chance: everything will be gone for good.
accountSection.yourDesignsStayOn: Your designs stay on this phone.
accountSection.verifyYourEmailTo: Verify your email to back up your designs to the cloud.
accountSection.cloudSavingIsNot: Cloud saving is not set up for this build. Designs stay on this phone.
accountSection.youAreUsingThe: You are using the app as a guest, which works fully. Sign in to back up designs and use them on other phones.

errorBoundary.thisScreenHitA: This screen hit a problem. Your designs are safe.

bottomSheet.dragToMoveTwist: Drag to move · twist to rotate · pinch to resize (80–125%)

permissionGate.hometownUsesTheCamera: HomeTown uses the camera to show furniture in your room. Nothing is recorded unless you take a photo or video.

statusBanner.removePiecesThatFailed: Remove pieces that failed to load

offlineBanner.youAreOfflineEverything: You are offline. Everything still works; backups resume when you are back online.

coachingOverlay.moveThePhoneSlowly: Move the phone slowly side to side, pointing at the floor in good light.

suggestionChips.placeAPieceAnd: Place a piece and suggestions that go with it appear here.

pieceList.noPiecesYetAdd: No pieces yet. Add one with the buttons above.

designIO.anchorNotAuthorized: Cloud anchors are not set up in this build (check the ReactVision key).
designIO.anchorMoveMore: Move around the room more so the phone sees enough of it, then try again.
designIO.anchorQuota: The cloud-anchor quota is used up. Try again later.
designIO.layoutReadyBody: {{count}} pieces around {{name}}. Aim at the floor and tap Place layout.

common.checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.

scan.tooSmallBody: The marked area is under {{area}} m². Undo and mark the real floor corners.
scan.notRectangle: This room is not a simple rectangle, so layouts are fitted to its bounding box. Check walkways by eye.
scan.tip: Tip: start the scan from the same corner next time to restore a saved design here.

placement.limitBody: Up to {{max}} pieces can be placed at once so the camera stays smooth. Delete one to add another.
placement.limitShort: Up to {{max}} pieces can be placed at once.

account.deleteBodySignedIn: This deletes your account, saved designs and saved furniture from our server and from this phone. It cannot be undone.
account.deleteBodyGuest: This deletes every saved design and setting on this phone. It cannot be undone.

fit.fitsWall: Fits along your longest wall ({{m}} m).
fit.tight: Tight: only {{cm}} cm spare in total.
fit.footprint: Footprint {{piece}} m² of about {{floor}} m² floor.

p360.photoWrap: 360° preview: true size, product photo wrapped on
p360.unavailable: The 3D view could not start, so here are the photos. Tap 360° view to try again.

roomPlan.design: Plan of your design, {{w}} by {{d}} centimetres

ar.qualityDropped: The camera view was slowing down, so AR quality was switched to Standard.
ar.statusScan: Scan: aim at a floor corner and tap Mark corner ({{n}} marked, need 3+).
ar.statusWall: Tap where the wall meets the floor: one end, then the other ({{n}}/2).
ar.statusOverlap: Pieces overlap. Drag one clear of the red outline.
ar.statusNarrow: Gap under 60 cm between pieces. Hard to walk through: consider moving one.
ar.statusLost: Tracking lost. Point back at where you were and move slowly.
ar.statusFound: Floor found. Aim the dot where you want it.
ar.statusScanFloor: Move your phone slowly to scan the floor.

auth.newCode: A new code is on its way.

rooms.designSub: Pick a room and a theme. We fit a matching set of HomeTown furniture into it and keep a running budget.
rooms.aiSub: Take one photo of your room. See which furniture we spot, or an AI restyle for ideas.

shared.gone: This shared design is no longer available. The owner may have stopped sharing it.

useCapture.checkPhotoPermissionsAnd: Check photo permissions and try again.

useDesignIO.thisBuildHasNo: This build has no cloud-anchor setup.
useDesignIO.couldNotFindYour: Could not find your room yet
useDesignIO.lookSlowlyAroundThe: Look slowly around the room where you pinned this (walls, floor, furniture edges) and tap again.
useDesignIO.couldNotReachThe: Could not reach the cloud-anchor service
useDesignIO.tapScanThenMark: Tap Scan, then Mark corner at the same room corner you used when you saved, and again further along a wall. Then tap Place layout.
useDesignIO.thisSampleRoomIs: This sample room is larger than the room you scanned. Place it anyway?
useDesignIO.placeAtLeastOne: Place at least one piece first.
useDesignIO.toBringItBack: To bring it back to the same spot, open it, tap Scan and mark the same room corner first, then a point along a wall. Accuracy is a few centimetres.
useDesignIO.findItUnderSaved: Find it under Saved. Reopening places it around the spot you aim at. To bring it back to the exact spot, scan the room (Tools, then Scan) before saving.
useDesignIO.placeAtLeastOne2: Place at least one piece on the floor first.
useDesignIO.scanTheFloorAround: Scan the floor around your furniture for about 30 seconds, then try again.
useDesignIO.openItFromSaved: Open it from Saved next time and tap "Find my room & place" while looking around the room. It is kept for 30 days.

usePlacement.thatIsALot: That is a lot of furniture
usePlacement.openToolsTapMark: Open Tools, tap Mark wall, then Add wall point where the wall meets the floor at one end, and again at the other end. Then aim near the wall and place.

useScan.standAtTheRoom: Stand at the room edge and tap Mark corner at each floor corner, going around the room.

usePlan.addAtLeastOne: Add at least one piece first.

hint.title: How to move your furniture

hint.twist: Twist with two fingers to turn it
hint.pinch: Pinch with two fingers to zoom in and out
hint.pinchResize: Pinch with two fingers to make it a little bigger or smaller
hint.slide: Slide one finger on the empty floor to move the view
hint.planLine: Drag to move · twist to turn · pinch to zoom · slide the floor to look around

roomAi.title: Redesign my room
roomAi.sub: One photo of your room: we spot the furniture in it, or show an AI restyle for ideas. Real HomeTown pieces are still placed at true size in AR.
roomAi.privacyBody: This photo is sent to our AI service to be analysed. It is shrunk and location data is removed first. It is deleted as soon as the AI has read it, and the results are deleted when you leave this screen. Nothing else from your camera ever leaves your phone.
roomAi.agree: I agree to send this one photo
roomAi.redesignNote: A restyle takes a few seconds. It is a picture for ideas, not exact products or sizes.
roomAi.failed: The AI could not process this photo. Try again.
roomAi.cameraDenied: Camera permission is off. Allow it in Settings, or choose a photo instead.
roomAi.nothingFound: We could not spot any furniture. Try a wider, brighter photo.
roomAi.inspiration: AI picture for ideas only. Use AR to place real HomeTown furniture at true size.
roomAi.offline: Redesign my room needs the HomeTown server. It is not set up in this version of the app.
roomAi.signIn: Sign in to use Redesign my room.
